title: Re-export layout and theme screenshots
changes: Re-run the screenshot optimizer to refresh dashboard layout and snow theme WebP exports

title: Unified page rhythm and full-viewport section bands
changes: Introduce a shared --v6-container width so subpages read at the same rhythm as the home story pin
Analytics & Reviews, Features and Workflow: sections snap as full-viewport bands while scrolling (off on small screens and with reduced motion)
Workflow: replace the pinned tool-screenshot scroller with an accessible tabbed showcase (keyboard-navigable, ARIA tabs)
Features: modules grid reflows from 2 to 4 columns to fit within one band
Customization: rename light theme presets 'Paper' → 'Soft' and 'Snow' → 'Whiteout'

title: Real product screenshots across the site
changes: Replace every marketing image with real product screenshots, served as theme-aware WebP
Add scripts/optimize-screenshots.mjs — resizes and re-encodes all screenshots (~94% smaller), run via npm run screenshots
Customization: interactive layout switches (density, sidebars) that drive the screenshot, with idle prefetch of the variants
Customization: theme comparison frame showing three dark tones / two light papers at once, plus its own light/dark preview toggle
Move the 'Numbers, your way' section from Customization to Analytics & Reviews
Workflow: pinned scroll-through of the tools, report and backup screens
Add a version number to the footer and start maintaining this changelog

title: Add bug report page
changes: Add /bugreport route with Tally form embed (placeholder ID, to be replaced once form is created)
Add 'Report a Bug' link in footer Company section across all locales
Add full translations for bug report page (EN, DE, ES, ZH)
Tally embed.js is loaded dynamically on the bug report page only
Direct email fallback to bugs@katsumii.com shown below the form
